purpose: Deterministic recipe for the production-contract adapter. It pins how compact benchmark fixtures become valid ProtectedClaimV1/ContextV2 inputs; it does not add production authority.

context_projection.product_binding: Map status/product_ids to ProductBindingV2 status/productIds; set schemaVersion=2, contractVersion=PRODUCT_BINDING_V2 and catalogVersion to context_projection.catalog_version.
context_projection.phase_and_barriers: Do not copy phase/barriers from the fixture into production evidence. Build canonical SalesCycleRuntimeState/readiness artifacts first and derive ContextV2.phase/barriers through buildContextV2. Fixture phase/barrier annotations are expectations that the production adapter must compare against the derived result.
context_projection.buying_intent: On PRODUCTION_CONTRACT, derive CanonicalDecisionEvidenceV1 from latest_customer_message through buildCanonicalDecisionEvidenceV1; context.buying_intent is an expectation and any decision/action/quantity/product mismatch rejects materialization. BEHAVIOR_SIMULATION may retain authored hypothetical intent.
context_projection.source_stage_note: Benchmark context.source_stage is an expectation for ContextV2.phase.sourceStage; the production adapter must prove that the canonical commerce state produces it rather than assigning it directly.

claim_projection.claimId: Derive an RFC4122 UUID deterministically from sha256("V5_BENCHMARK_CLAIM_ID_V1\n" + runtime_claim_ref).

scope.PRODUCT: copy productId; copy variantId when present, otherwise null
scope.CART: set cartId to "eval-cart-v{cartVersion}" and copy cartVersion
